# Color variables

<!-- Generated from Lever UI CSS by `pnpm generate:theme-reference`. Do not edit. -->

[All variables](README.md)

A shade, such as `blue-500`, is the same in light and dark mode. A role,
such as `blue-subtle`, changes with the mode. See every color as a swatch
on the [Colors](../colors.md) page.

## Palette aliases

These point at whichever palette is in use. Set the palette with
`colorPalette` on a component, or `data-lui-color-palette` on any
element. Gray is the default.

| Variable                                | Means                                         |
| --------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `--lui-colors-color-palette-50`         | Shade 50 of the current palette.              |
| `--lui-colors-color-palette-100`        | Shade 100 of the current palette.             |
| `--lui-colors-color-palette-200`        | Shade 200 of the current palette.             |
| `--lui-colors-color-palette-300`        | Shade 300 of the current palette.             |
| `--lui-colors-color-palette-400`        | Shade 400 of the current palette.             |
| `--lui-colors-color-palette-500`        | Shade 500 of the current palette.             |
| `--lui-colors-color-palette-600`        | Shade 600 of the current palette.             |
| `--lui-colors-color-palette-700`        | Shade 700 of the current palette.             |
| `--lui-colors-color-palette-800`        | Shade 800 of the current palette.             |
| `--lui-colors-color-palette-900`        | Shade 900 of the current palette.             |
| `--lui-colors-color-palette-950`        | Shade 950 of the current palette.             |
| `--lui-colors-color-palette-border`     | The `border` role of the current palette.     |
| `--lui-colors-color-palette-contrast`   | The `contrast` role of the current palette.   |
| `--lui-colors-color-palette-emphasized` | The `emphasized` role of the current palette. |
| `--lui-colors-color-palette-fg`         | The `fg` role of the current palette.         |
| `--lui-colors-color-palette-focus-ring` | The `focus-ring` role of the current palette. |
| `--lui-colors-color-palette-muted`      | The `muted` role of the current palette.      |
| `--lui-colors-color-palette-solid`      | The `solid` role of the current palette.      |
| `--lui-colors-color-palette-subtle`     | The `subtle` role of the current palette.     |
